content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
First, I need to confirm your identity. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 600.00 past due and is 14 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of these today?
I can't pay today, but I can pay both full amounts on October twenty-third.
To confirm: the credit card, 900.00 on Friday 23 October 2026; the personal loan, 600.00 on Tuesday 20 October 2026, which is the latest date I can record for it. Do you confirm this?
Yes, I confirm the card on the twenty-third and the loan on the twentieth.

Your promise is recorded: the credit card, 900.00 on Friday 23 October 2026; the personal loan, 600.00 on Tuesday 20 October 2026. Your promise has been saved in your customer portal. Is there anything else I can help you with?
No, that's everything, thanks for your help. Goodbye.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
